ts = list(map(int, input().split()))
T = int(input())

ts.sort()

result = 1
for i in range(n):
    j = i
    while j + 1 < n and ts[j + 1] - ts[i] <= T:
        j += 1
    result = max(result, j - i + 1)

print(result)
